{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Return current move action (used in [[playAction]], [[playActionNow]] and [[switchAction]])

|s1= [unit, returnConfig] call [[BIS_fnc_moveAction]]

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|p2= returnConfig: [[Boolean]] - (Optional, default [[false]]) [[true]] to return action config path, [[false]] to return the action name

|r1= [[Config]] or [[String]] - depends on ''returnConfig''

|x1= <sqf>
_actionName		= [player, false] call BIS_fnc_moveAction;
_actionConfig	= [player,  true] call BIS_fnc_moveAction;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[playAction]] [[playActionNow]] [[switchAction]] [[playMove]] [[switchMove]]
}}
